BLEOwnershipReview: Only DataSlot.data changes from embedded2304-byte array to a pointer. Eight pointers map to eight distinct contiguous2304-byte regions; CTRL512-byte arrays and the512-byte TX scratch remain embedded/internal. The18432-byte allocation excludes RTOS structures and guard/slot metadata.

Init takes its existing same-mux one-time claim before allocating. Payload storage is allocated after the final memset of s_ble and before guard timer, queues, tasks and SDK initialization. Bindings are complete before txQueue/GATT admission can make producers eligible.

One explicit heap_caps_malloc(SPIRAM|8BIT) occurs outside s_bleMux. No internal fallback, runtime allocation, free or reallocation path is added. Failed allocation sets guard/init error toNO_MEM and stays failed for this boot; later initialization failure retains permanent storage and references.

All pointer assignments occur within a short metadata critical section; payload memcpy/CRC and SDK calls remain outside. Payload bytes need not be zeroed: only validated nonzero length<=2304 is used after complete copy to an exclusively reserved slot.

WRITING cannot be consumed/superseded; PENDING/OWNED generation checks and same-mux transitions remain unchanged. Disconnect/reconnect, stream changes, SDK quarantine and late return do not free or replace the backing allocation. Slot reuse still waits for actual owner return.

The installed SDK synchronously copies GATT values before posting BTC work. This is CPU source storage, not a peripheral DMA descriptor or ADS buffer. Fragment scratch remains internal, and small direct packets still keep their slot until SDK actually returns.
No sizeof(slot.data) length regression was found; payload limit/offsets use MESSAGE_VALUE_MAX. Existing full/SHORT, CRC, descriptor and protected ticket identities are unchanged.
